newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Retevision sale at beginning of April.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Retevision sale at beginning of April.

text.p: The sale of 60-80 percent of Spanish state telecommunications group Retevision will take place at the beginning of April, local media reported on Thursday.

Communications Secretary Jose Manuel Villar said Retevision's interconnection tariffs would be published in March paving the way for the privatisation details later in the month and the sale "at the beginning of April".

"The interconnection tariffs -- the price Retevision and other new operators will pay to use Telefonica's infrastructure -- will be generous," Villar was quoted as saying in Spanish financial daily Expansion.
But although generous, Villar said the tariffs would "try to cause the least damage possible to Telefonica".
Retevision, Spain's second telecommunications operator after Telefonica de Espana, is due to be fully privatised by 2000.
Last Friday, the cabinet announced that Retevision's value was some 76 billion pesetas ($530 million).
